notes.title: Steam Deck verified and further improvements.
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we hope you're having a great weekend! 

Some of you may have noticed recent patch notes mentioning various font size fixes throughout the game. That’s because we've been making sure the font is legible across the board - and meets certification standards for the Steam Deck. As a result we're thrilled to announce that [i]Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall[/i] is now: 
[h1][b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]![/h1]

We're continuing to improve the game. Recently, we increased the difficulty in Chapter 2 after noticing many of you felt it wasn't challenging enough. We've also removed the reset of resources between chapters - we understand that was frustrating for some of you.

On top of that, we're actively working on the Mac version of the game. If you're using an Apple computer, keep an eye out as we will have news for you very soon!

As always, thank you all for the continued support. We read your comments and reviews, and take your feedback on board! If you haven’t left a review yet, please consider doing so - it helps us more than you know!

Yours,
Brave Team x

notes.title: Post-Launch Update: A Rough First Week
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Queens and Kings of Davern,[/h3]
Last week, we launched a game you’d been looking forward to for a long time and it didn’t deliver. The game contained multiple blockers, froze frequently, and wasn’t in a playable state for many.

We messed up. We’re sorry, and we take full responsibility.

[h3]What happened?[/h3]
We were too ambitious and stretched our team too thin. We tried to create interwoven quests with branching paths and dynamic outcomes for both agents and the family, but it was more than our small team of four could handle.

[b]Did you not test your own game?[/b]
We did - extensively. We had multiple QA testers, ran several public demos, a Steam beta, and even showcased the game at Gamescom. But the reality is: no amount of internal or closed testing can match the creativity and unpredictability of thousands of real players. That doesn’t make it okay. We should have found a way to fix the bugs or made a smaller game, with less branching, better suited to our team size.

[h3]Where are we now and what’s next?[/h3]
As of today, we’ve fixed around 99% of all game-breaking bugs. The game is now stable for the vast majority of players. Could something obscure - something that hasn’t happened to thousands of players - still slip through? Yes. But if it does, we’ll be here to fix it. We’re not going anywhere.

We’ll continue fixing what’s left and improving the game over time. We have a list of small improvements we want to add, so we’re likely to keep updating the game in the months to come.

We listen to your feedback and do our best to make it a reality. If you have any thoughts, wishes, or requests, you can join our active Discord server or leave a thread on the Steam Discussions.

[b]On a positive note:[/b]
Since the major fixes, the game has been receiving a lot of very positive reviews. In the past two days, our average score has been 87%, confirming that  (once the issues are fixed) players are really enjoying what *Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall* has to offer.

[h3]Thank you <3[/h3]
We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who’s been supportive over the past week. Your words of encouragement, trust, and love for the game are the reason we keep doing this.

[b]If you’ve enjoyed the game despite the rocky start, we’d be deeply grateful if you’d consider leaving us a review on Steam.[/b]

If you’re still experiencing issues, please make sure you’ve downloaded the latest build and read our patch notes. Some bugs were unfortunately “saved” in your most recent save and may require replaying from a previous week. In any case, you can always reach us on Discord and we can help there.

Thank you for your patience, understanding and sticking with us.
Brave Team.

notes.title: The Scribes Have Been Busy…
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’ve been working around the clock since launch and wanted to give you a quick update. We’re really excited to hear that (aside from encountering some bugs) you have all been enjoying the game so far! We're happy to report that [b]five patches[/b] have gone out since yesterday, addressing a wide range of bugs that have surfaced.

We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has taken the time to report issues - your support is helping us massively. The game has many branching paths and complex possibilities, and some of you have managed to do things in orders we never even imagined! It's been both eye-opening and genuinely helpful in identifying edge cases and unexpected outcomes.

We’ll be the first to admit: we didn’t anticipate this many players at launch. It’s been overwhelming in the best possible way, and while the situation caught us a little off-guard, we’re getting a better grasp with every hour.

If you're curious about the fixes, you can find the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1373090?emclan=103582791473746037&emgid=506202246554322761][here][/url]

Once again, thank you so much for playing, supporting, and sticking with us, it means a lot <3

Brave Team

notes.title: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
📜Dear peasants of Davern!

It is my greatest pleasure to announce that you can now grab your crown, some wine and a controller and go play Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall 👑

[h1]YES, YOUR GRACE 2: SNOWFALL IS OUT NOW![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/cb9c6664be47a3392dc52dd274cd8aec9df96565.jpg[/img]

We have poured our hearts into this game and we really hope you like it. Everything you loved about [i]Yes, Your Grace [/i]- we turned up to eleven 🔊

- The story is filled with twists and turns 🔀
- Tough choices at every corner ⚠️
- Resource management like you’ve never seen before 💥
- See different queue quests ever time you replay ✅
- Side quests, side quests and side quests - You loved the agents, they will now have meaningful storylines!
- Upgrades, collecting taxes and passing laws ⚖️
- Aaaaaand more‼️ the game is filled to the brims with all sorts of improvements



We wanted to thank [b]every single[/b] one of you, many of you have been waiting for this game for a long time and supporting us for so many years! Your support has been invaluable all the way and we truly could not have made this game without this support ❤️

We will keep working on the game and update it in the coming months. We have a long list of updates that we will be working on as soon as the launch dust settles. 

We really love hearing your feedback - be it good or bad, so make sure to leave us a review on Steam (this is *very* important for us in the first weeks of launch - it helps to get the game more visibility) ❤️



We really hope you will enjoy the game, we will be available to chat to on our Discord, so come join us here: https://discord.com/invite/yesyourgrace

notes.title: Happy Holidays, Potato-Heads!
notes.content:
We’ve been a bit quiet lately, but that’s because we’ve been deep in our basements, hard at work on the game.

But worry not, this year has been both fruitful and exhausting!

Hmm… one could say spectacular even!

The game has come a long way, and we’ve achieved some incredible milestones:

- Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall was nominated and won several awards:
    - DevGamm Vilnus 2024 - Excellence in Game Design Winner
    - Indie Cup 2024 - Rising Star Award Winner
    - DevGamm Lisbon 2024 - Excellence in Narrative Winner
    - Debug Indie Game Awards - Most Anticipated Game Nominee
    - and many, many more but let it not get it into our heads! 😮‍💨✨
- We have launched public Snowfall demo in May for LudonarraCon!
- We have hosted our very own festival on Steam - Pixelated showcasing you more of Snowfall as well as plenty other fantastic pixelated games!
- We launched [i]Yes, Your Grace[/i] on mobile and even won Best Indie Game at the Google Play awards!
- We also had the pleasure of meeting some of you at Gamescom! Thank you for anyone checking out our booth!

There’s still plenty of work ahead, but next year is [i]the year[/i]—we’re beyond excited to share all the treasures we’ve been crafting.

As this year wraps up, we hope you find time to rest, eat well, spend time with your loved ones, and avoid any suspiciously familiar scarves.

May your sacks be full of potatoes, your gold never run dry, your supplies stay plentiful, and your happiness bar maxed out. Oh, and try not to get caught in a Snowfall.

[b]Stay safe, stay brave, and we’ll see you in 2025![/b]

notes.title: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall Release Date Delay
notes.content:
[h3]We have some important news regarding Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall Release Date[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/72cedbc151d063132983ce5b484e0a7b88bcec26.png[/img]



---


Since announcing Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall at Summer Game Fest last year we have been flooded with positive comments and excitement about the game. We are just as excited for you to get your hands on the game but we have some important news to share with you regarding our release date.

Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall won’t make our 2024 release goal and we are moving the launch date to Q1 2025.

This game is extremely special to us and we want to make sure we deliver something that will stay in your memory for a very long time after you’ve played it. As you might already know, the sequel has been rebuilt from scratch to allow us to improve the visuals, management mechanics, queue system, story system etc. and whilst these improvements have undeniably made the game miles better, we still have a way to go to make it into a game we’ll be proud to ship.

We are really looking forward to sharing more about the game soon, so keep an eye on our channels in the next few weeks for updates.

Thank you so much to all of you have have shown us support since announcement, we see you <3 

Stay Brave,

Alina & Rafal

notes.title: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall Dev Stream Incoming!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year Gamers!!! 🤩[/h1]

It’s 2024 😲 this means we are so much closer to the Snowfall launch! We cannot wait to share the rest of the game with you and see your reactions to it *(we’re all secretly hoping you’re going to sob your eyes out when you find out what we did to your favourite characters <evil laugh>)*

Snowfall Beta took us by surprise a little bit, we have received much more feedback than anticipated so if you’ve participated in it thank you so much <3 we’re very thankful to have such an amazing and active community of *potato-heads* helping us make this game.

We have been very busy working through your feedback and we’re so close 🤏 to being back on track after implementing the most important changes.

[h1]Brand New Input System[/h1]

Whoop whoop! The most requested feature was the ability to change how you control the game and it’s almost done! You will now be able to play the game with keyboard only/mouse only or a combination of both (or a controller!).

[h1]Audry is back ✨[/h1]

Depending on the decisions you made in Yes, Your Grace, you will either be assigned a brand new Advisor, or be reunited with your most trusted family friend.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/b65735e3b4d06e92e02461d9a10c8daaf34bea9c.gif[/img]

[h1]New story flow 🤫[/h1]

We have revisited some character arcs in Chapter 1, shortened the whole chapter to make it more cohesive and improve the flow! There has been some exciting changes but we will leave it for you to discover for yourself *soon*!

[h1]Waka waka[/h1]

I’m happy to report that 90% of the cast now has a voice 🗣️ We’re still working on polishing them up, but you were right!! The characters feel 100% more alive and emotional now *(you asked for it, don’t blame us if they make you cry now).*

Aside from aaaaaall of the above, we have brand new animations, redesigned how threat events work in the game, wrote a lot of new dialogues for the remaining chapters and changed how the Yes, Your Grace decisions will be imported into the game (more info on that later) ✨

I think it’s safe to say we’ve had a VERY busy past few months! 🔥🥵🔥

[h2]That’s not all 😲[/h2]

We have a couple of exciting announcements to share with you as well:

[h1]Yes, Your Grace is coming to mobiles THIS WEEK!![/h1]

We have partnered with Noodlecake to bring Yes, Your Grace to Android and IOS on February 1st 🎉

We have been working on this in secret for a very long time so we hope you enjoy playing through the story again *(or for the first time!)* on your phone ✨

- The first hour of the game is free to play
- The game will cost $4.99
- 20% discount will apply during the launch week

Get it on AppStore or Google Play Store!


[h1] Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall ❄️ award nomination[/h1]

Our game was nominated for *“Most anticipated game”* award at the DEBUG awards 😭🥺

It means so much to us that so many of you are patiently awaiting the release of the game so thank you! If you would like Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall to win the award, you can vote for us here: https://www.teamdebug.com/awards/vote


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/17aebb12513b0efea275f4767822f60c870634c0.png[/img]

[h1]Story Tellers Festival 📖🤓📖[/h1]

We are coming to the Story Tellers Festival to celebrate amazing stories told through the medium of games! 

We absolutely love to discover new story-driven games so if you do too, come find us at the fest alongside other awesome games <3

As a part of the festival we will be doing a DEV STREAM of Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall 😲 so if you would like a small 🤏 peek of the changes we have implemented since beta, come along to the store page on January 30th at 6pm GMT. 

To remember, you can set a reminder by pressing the ‘Remind Me’ button on the right side of this news (or add it to your calendar) 🙏 We hope to see you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/68c4c12b9ee05984bf1d14eb0881a71afe82fd99.png[/img]

Here is to awesome 2024 🎉 🍾

Stay Brave xx

notes.title: Development Update #2 - Are we switching engines?
notes.content:
A very exciting progress update on Snowfall this month! Read on to get a little sneak peak of some new animations, concept art and plans for the future!

As our team prepares for the Autumn months and we work comfortably wrapped in cosy blankets, we are getting ready to release a Beta build for all of you to try very soon. Keep an eye on the news here for updates! The Beta version will allow you to play through the first hour of the game, featuring random queue quests, new characters and our brand new management mechanics. We're excited to hear your feedback on these new systems! <3

In the past month we have organised a little field trip to the castle that inspired it all - Malbork castle in Gdansk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/994d2885b582141852f5d500ec24872f01e762a5.jpg[/img]

We have gathered some interesting textures, stories and historical facts to help us make the game even more interesting! - Did you know the castle, built in 1400s, had underfloor heating?!


In the meantime, the team has been diligently working on a chapter system. Have been writing captivating main storyline dialogues for chapter III, and also putting a lot of effort effort towards creating numerous new animations that will enhance the overall visual experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/0808ddcd3af5f7e10b566f88f9e813149244afcd.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/0fb4f15748b5861231dd00b0a259c61779d77bfd.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/c08db1174a8008f6b03c3ed9589aa41aabbef7c8.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/21f32cd0b73f719eda60cb0c5a7389823a3376b4.gif[/img]

We also have some lovely concept art pieces for new scenes and some that are already in game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/21d7f499c7e4147ab0b659e9c345b7738c0e6b09.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/87d9e4ee9014a0c007a476181f7e22055e7d429f.jpg[/img]

I'm thrilled to share that the development of the game is going at a fantastic pace right now, and I couldn't be happier to inform you that we are not only meeting but also surpassing all of our milestones and marketing goals. We've been making remarkable progress, and I'm excited to announce that next month is going to be jam-packed with exciting updates. Get ready for new reveals, a fresh and revamped UI, and an epic new trailer that will surely blow you away!

[h2]Unity, Unity, Unity🙄[/h2]

Game development never goes smoothly, and this time is no exception. We have encountered several challenges along the way. Recently, the game engine we use, Unity, announced significant changes to their pricing structure. In addition to the monthly fee, we may also have to pay additional fees based on the number of game installs after a certain threshold. This will have an impact on both Yes, Your Grace and Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall, especially if we decide to participate in subscription-based or charity programs on various platforms. These programs can greatly increase the number of game installs.

We have had numerous discussions in the studio this week, and while we are disappointed with Unity's decisions, we are too far into development to switch engines. Doing so would result in major release delays. We have dedicated years to building our own development workflows and tools around Unity, so this is not a decision we take lightly. However, for future projects, we are likely to explore different game engines.


If you haven’t already, add the game to your wishlist and if you are enjoying these development updates make sure to click that thumbs up button <3



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373090/Yes_Your_Grace_Snowfall/

notes.title: Yes, Your Grace Sequel is here!
notes.content:
Attention all kings, queens and monarchs! We are EXTREMELY EXCTED to announce [i]*Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall[/i],* a cinematic kingdom management RPG where you take the role of Eryk, the King of Davern. Rule over your Kingdom, manage resources, make alliances and care for your family. Be prepared to make difficult decisions and be pushed to the edge of your seat over and over again.

[previewyoutube=2f0Maue64nU;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]*Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall[/i]* will follow the story of Eryk and his royal family, whose Kingdom is yet again on the brink of collapse. Get ready to lose yourself in a world full of Slavic myths and creatures, overcome hardships together with your family and stay alert as there is always someone eyeing your throne. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/4b6ca166099fad538b7f8599a97a1316b7d0134f.gif[/img]

But hold on tight! It’s not just the cinematic visuals and captivating story that will keep you playing turn after turn. [i]i*Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall[/i]* will include brand-new management gameplay that will challenge your strategic prowess. A randomised queue of petitioners will always keep you on your toes, and with more than one solution to satisfy each character, you’ll never run out of options. Keeping your resources balanced will prove more challenging, but worry not - you’ll have an Advisor by your side who’ll always remind you - not everyone has the Kingdom’s best interest at heart…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/33bc144fa7c2135c197b2245b45a2f36f7bdce48.gif[/img]

Are you brave enough to step into Eryk's shoes?

Get hyped with us and the rest of the community by wishlisting the game and joining our Discord, where you can chat with the devs, ask us questions and follow the development!

(we can't stress enough how helpful every wishlist is 💗)
